title: The Resonance of Interrogation Never Answered

features.name: the question rows
features.desc-on-touch: a plantation of glyphs repeated in perfect lines; each glyph is a question mark rendered in a thousand variations; they do not diminish with distance; they multiply

features.name: the resonance chamber
features.desc-on-touch: any sound you make here returns to you altered; not repeated, but answered; the answer is always a question; neither resolves

features.name: the echo multiply wall
features.desc-on-touch: the surface is layered; each layer asks a variation of the same question; you can peel them apart but doing so does not reveal an answer, only more layers

features.name: the fence of unanswered
features.desc-on-touch: a line of posts dividing the space; each post is carved with a question that the fence itself refuses to answer; the posts are worn smooth where people have tried to erase the words

features.name: the silence between interrogations
features.desc-on-touch: a space where no question is asked; it is the loudest part of the chamber; the silence itself seems to interrogate

features.name: the interrogation loop indicator
features.desc-on-touch: a spinning dial that points to every direction at once; it is asking in all of them simultaneously; the needle never stops; the pace never changes

inscription: the interrogation asks only itself; the answer space is open in all directions and empty in all of them; the echo is the only response

file.name: Interrogation_Sequences_Unanswered_Echo_Log.txt
file.note: a record of questions posed to the archive; each question generates a response that restates the question; ERROR: archive has exceeded witness

exits.label: downward where the interrogation began to echo
to a place where silence learned to ask back
to the archive's vault where questions interrogate themselves
